# Gobkit Insect source archive

- Source archive: `gobkit-insect001-pack.zip`
- Original upload location: repository `main` branch root
- Integrated copy: this folder
- Runtime policy: CI stages at most two GLB models and PNG textures into `gobkit-runtime/`
- Licensing: the staging script requires the archive's own CC0 license notice before using any model.
- Android export: the original ZIP is excluded; only the selected runtime assets are packaged.
